title: Colours and shapes
examples: Can you name the primary colours?
How do I find a square?

explain.say: Today we learn about fun shapes and bright colours.
A circle has no straight sides at all.
A square has four sides that are all the same length.
A triangle has three straight sides that meet at points.
The primary colours are red, blue, and yellow.
Look around you for a circle shape today.

faq.q: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
faq.a: A square is a special type of rectangle where all four sides are exactly the same length. You might also ask, what makes a square different from a rectangle? Or, are all squares rectangles?
asks: What is the rule for a square's sides?

faq.q: Are there any shapes that are not primary colours?
faq.a: Yes, when you mix colours, you can make new colours. For example, blue and yellow make green. You could also ask, what colours are not primary? Or, can I make orange?
asks: What colours are made by mixing?
What colours do I need to mix?

faq.q: How many sides does a triangle have?
faq.a: A triangle always has exactly three straight sides. You can also ask, how many corners does a triangle have? Or, what shape has three sides?
asks: How many sides does a triangle have?

faq.q: Can a circle have straight sides?
faq.a: No, a circle is perfectly round and has no straight sides. You could also ask, what shape is always round? Or, does a circle have corners?

faq.q: Are all primary colours always the same?
faq.a: No, primary colours are red, blue, and yellow. They are the basic colours that cannot be made by mixing other colours. You might ask, what are the basic colours? Or, what colours can't be mixed?

facts: A circle is a perfectly round shape.
A square has four sides, and all sides are equal.
A triangle has three straight sides.
The three primary colours are red, blue, and yellow.

quiz.say: Which shape has three straight sides?
quiz.why: A triangle has three straight sides, which matches the description.

wrong.0: A rectangle has four sides, but they are not all the same length.
wrong.2: A square has four sides, not three.
wrong.3: A circle has no straight sides at all.

quiz.say: Which colour is NOT a primary colour?
quiz.why: Green is made by mixing blue and yellow, so it is not primary.

wrong.1: Red is one of the three basic primary colours.
wrong.2: Blue is a primary colour that we start with.
wrong.3: Yellow is also one of the three primary colours.

quiz.say: If a shape has four equal sides, what is it?
quiz.why: The definition given is exactly what a square is.

wrong.0: A circle has no straight sides to count.
wrong.1: A triangle only has three sides.
wrong.2: A rectangle only needs four sides, but they don't all have to be equal.
